v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: All ye nations * shout unto God with the voice of joy.

text.la: Inténde * voci oratiónis meæ, Rex meus et Deus meus.
text.en: Hearken to the voice * of my prayer, O my King and my God.

text.la: Deus maiestátis * intónuit: afférte glóriam nómini eius.
text.en: The God of majesty * hath thundered, ascribe to the Lord glory to his name.

text.la: Laudámus nomen tuum * ínclitum, Deus noster.
text.en: O God of majesty, * we praise thy glorious name.
O praise the Lord, * all ye nations. ‡

text.la: Nox præcéssit, dies autem appropinquávit. Abiciámus ergo ópera tenebrárum, et induámur arma lucis. Sicut in die honéste ambulémus.
text.en: The night is passed, and the day is at hand. Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and put on the armour of light. Let us walk honestly, as in the day.

v.en: We are filled in the morning with thy mercy.

r.en: And we have rejoiced, and are delighted.

text.la: Benedíctus * Dóminus Deus Israël, quia visitávit et liberávit nos.
text.en: Blessed be the Lord * the God of Israel, because he has visited and redeemed his people.

text.la: Deus virtútum, cuius est totum quod est óptimum: ínsere pectóribus nostris amórem tui nóminis, et præsta in nobis religiónis augméntum; ut, quæ sunt bona, nútrias, ac pietátis stúdio, quæ sunt nutríta, custódias.
text.en: Lord of all power and might, Who art the Author and Giver of all good things, graft in our hearts the love of thy Name, increase in us true religion, nourish us with all goodness, and, of thy great mercy, keep us in the same.

text.la: Euge, serve bone et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
text.en: Well done, thou good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: Deus, qui nos beáti Aléxii Confessóris tui ánnua solemnitáte lætíficas: concéde propítius; ut cuius natalítia cólimus, étiam actiónes imitémur.
text.en: O God, Who, year by year, dost gladden us by the solemn feast-day of thy blessed confessor Alexis, mercifully grant unto all who keep his birthday, grace to follow after the pattern of his godly conversation.

office.title: Feria secunda infra Hebd VI post Octavam Pentecostes
